clauses.title: Governance as design property
clauses.text: All AI and digital systems within the organization shall embed governance as an intrinsic design property, not as a retrospective compliance overlay.

clauses.title: Authoritative Data Source primacy
clauses.text: Every action taken by an AI agent or governed system shall be recorded in an append-only Authoritative Data Source with cryptographic integrity.

clauses.title: Role-based jurisdiction with structural enforcement
clauses.text: Agent actions shall be constrained by role-based jurisdiction enforced at execution time rather than by post-hoc audit.

clauses.title: Human oversight for Tier-1 and Tier-2 changes
clauses.text: Modifications to sovereign and constitutional governance artefacts shall require explicit human authorization via the Sovereign Change Request mechanism.

clauses.title: Transparency through public audit surface
clauses.text: The organization shall publish which standards have been adopted, adapted or dismissed, with rationale, to support external verification of governance claims.
